author: Logos V
title: Logos V: Principled Innovation - FWPCA -> Harmony -> kNN
abstract: Building on the success of the 'First Principles' baseline (ID 1025, score 0.6578), this experiment introduces a single, principled innovation. It replaces the standard PCA input to Harmony with a Feature-Weighted PCA (FWPCA, alpha=0.5). This tests the hypothesis that a better input representation will significantly improve the performance of the robust Harmony->kNN pipeline.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import numpy as np
import scanpy as sc
import anndata as ad
from scipy.sparse import issparse

def _normalize_log1p_inplace(adata, target_sum=1e4):
    sc.pp.normalize_total(adata, target_sum=target_sum, inplace=True)
    sc.pp.log1p(adata)

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata):
    n_pcs = 50
    k_neighbors = 50
    alpha_var = 0.5 # FWPCA parameter
    
    _normalize_log1p_inplace(adata, 1e4)
    sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(adata, flavor='seurat_v3', batch_key='batch', n_top_genes=2000, inplace=True)
    hv = adata.var['highly_variable']
    
    X_hvg = adata.X[:, hv]
    Xd = X_hvg.A if issparse(X_hvg) else X_hvg
    
    # 1. Feature-Weighted PCA (FWPCA)
    var_g = Xd.var(axis=0, ddof=1) + 1e-8
    wv = np.power(var_g, -0.5 * alpha_var)
    Xw = Xd * wv
    
    ad_temp = ad.AnnData(Xw)
    sc.pp.pca(ad_temp, n_comps=n_pcs, random_state=0)
    adata.obsm['X_pca'] = ad_temp.obsm['X_pca'] # Use FWPCA result as input for Harmony

    # 2. Harmony for batch correction
    sc.external.pp.harmony_integrate(adata, key='batch', basis='X_pca', adjusted_basis='X_harmony', max_iter_harmony=20)
    
    # 3. Vanilla kNN on the Harmony-corrected space
    sc.pp.neighbors(adata, use_rep='X_harmony', n_neighbors=k_neighbors, metric='cosine')

    adata.obsm['X_emb'] = adata.obsm['X_harmony']
    
    return adata
